output.headline: Zeke Mbeki's close-range strike gives Ironvale a hard-fought win
output.text: Northgate Rovers started the brighter side, passing it around patiently, and Oscar Blum nearly scored from right in front of goal, but his shot was blocked. Just a minute later, Ironvale Athletic punished them. Zeke Mbeki pounced from close range and fired home. After that, Ironvale sat deep and stayed compact. Callum Reid and Hiro Tanaka kept snapping into tackles and winning the ball back. Mbeki almost doubled the lead just before half-time but put his shot wide. In the second half, Rovers kept the ball but couldn't find a way through, while Ironvale broke forward whenever they could. The home side held on to win 1-0. Mbeki was the standout player, scoring the winner and working hard everywhere.
